sources.description: January–February 2024. Official PRCS documentation of the deaths of paramedics Yusuf Zeino and Ahmed al-Madhoun and of Hind Rajab, whose car was struck by 335 bullets by Israeli Occupation Forces.
sources.label: Palestinian Red Crescent Society — Documentation of Hind Rajab and Paramedic Killings

sources.description: 2024. Forensic Architecture's reconstruction of the events of January 29, 2024, confirming IOF responsibility for the deaths of Hind Rajab and the two paramedics dispatched to rescue her.
sources.label: Forensic Architecture — Investigation: Killing of Hind Rajab and PRCS Paramedics

sources.description: April 2024. HRW investigation concluding that Israeli forces unlawfully killed Hind Rajab, Yusuf Zeino, and Ahmed al-Madhoun in Gaza City on January 29, 2024.
sources.label: Human Rights Watch — Israeli Forces Killed Palestinian Child Hind Rajab and Paramedics

sources.description: 2024. +972 Magazine's investigative coverage of the Hind Rajab case, IOF internal review, and the deliberate targeting of the PRCS ambulance.
sources.label: +972 Magazine — The Killing of Hind Rajab

sources.description: 2024. Middle East Eye coverage documenting Hind's phone call to PRCS, the family members killed around her, and international response.
sources.label: Middle East Eye — Hind Rajab: The Child the World Heard Die

sources.description: 2024. Electronic Intifada reporting on the Hind Rajab case, IOF denial and subsequent internal review, and ongoing impunity.
sources.label: Electronic Intifada — Hind Rajab coverage and IOF accountability
